name: std::mdspan<T,Extents,LayoutPolicy,AccessorPolicy>::static_extent

declarations.code: static constexpr std::size_t static_extent(rank_type r) noexcept;

intro: Statically determines the extent of a mdspan at the rank index r. If the rank index r corresponds to a dynamic extent, returns std::dynamic_extent. Equivalent to return Extents::static_extent(r);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
r

 -

 The rank index to get the static extent size of

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The static extent size, or std::dynamic_extent.
